title: Fiat's Bitcoin Challenge
script_summary:
# PROTOCOL PULSE BRIEF

Bitcoin's at 75K while fiat collapses—that's not ideology, that's chain data talking.

Hashrate just hit 1035 exahashes. Network security is bulletproof. Meanwhile, global currencies hemorrhage credibility by the day.

Here's what matters: market dominance cracked 57%. That's not noise. That's Bitcoin absorbing the capital fleeing broken monetary systems.

The signal's crystal clear from three angles. Szabo's right—banking regulations killed financial freedom decades ago.
